notes: 'and' is `added`: the Hebrew juxtaposes `זְכֹר מִלְחָמָה` and `אַל־תּוֹסַף` with no waw (rule 14's closing sentence).
'no' to the prohibitive `אַל` and 'do so ... more' to `יָסַף`, headed on 'more' as the word carrying the repetition; the alternative fusion 'no more' on the negative is the competing reading.
